newsitem.title: FRANCE: Activity picks up on France's Nouveau Marche.
newsitem.headline: Activity picks up on France's Nouveau Marche.

text.p: Daily volume on the French small cap stockmarket, the Nouveau Marche, doubled in March from the preceding month and was more than four times higher than the 1996 average, the Nouveau Marche said on Wednesday.
It said daily volume last month averaged 32.01 million francs, compared with 16.27 million in February.
Since its opening on March 20, 1996, the market has raised 1.88 billion francs of capital. At the end of March, 23 companies were listed, two of them foreign, the Nouveau Marche said in a statement.
